label: early input e (first 3 positions), or h at position 0
explanation: Fires almost entirely during the original-input phase at positions t=0..2, when the input token is e (92% of activation mass), plus weakly when h is the very first token (about 5% of mass, activations ~0.02 of max). Magnitude: e at t=0 is a constant ~0.31 of max; the strongest activations are the copy-phase echo of e for L=3 sequences (e fed back at t=4, up to 1.0) and e at t=2 after certain prefixes such as k c (~0.56). e at t=1 is usually weak. Never fires at the delimiter, essentially never in the copy phase except that L=3 echo, never at t>=3 of the original phase, and almost never on other tokens. Main false positives are e at t=1-2 that stay under threshold, especially after an earlier h.

issues: The false positives are not scattered noise. Whether e at t=1 fires depends entirely on the token before it (dev, about 100 steps per prefix). It fires every time when prev_tok is outside {b,e,g,h,i,m,o,x,z} and never when prev_tok is in that set. So 'e at t=1 is usually weak' and 'false positives especially after an earlier h' both understate a deterministic, systematic class of false positives.

e at t=2 is worse: precision is only 0.36 (3323 predicted steps). The predicate's term (in_tok==e)&(t<=2) therefore overclaims for t=2. Most of the leftover false positives after filtering on prev_tok are e at t=2 with particular two-token prefixes.

h at t=0 is described as a minor weak case (~5% of mass). It has precision 1.0 and covers 29% of all active steps (dev recall 0.288), though only 3.1% of activation mass. By step count it is about as large a mode as e at t=0 (29.3%).

The magnitude claims check out: e at t=0 has precision 1.0 and 60% of mass. The L=3 copy-phase echo of e at t=4 has precision 0.88 but only 1.2% of mass. There are no activations at the delimiter or at t>=3 of the original phase.

Remaining misses form small systematic classes in the original phase at t=1-2: p, h, s and v after particular first tokens (e.g. 'c p', 'c h', 'k 2 h'). There are also copy-phase echoes of other first tokens in L=3 sequences (e.g. v at t=4). Together they hold about 6-7% of mass.
skeptic.revised_label: First token e or h (always active). Also active on e at t=1 or t=2 unless the preceding token(s) fall in {b,e,g,h,i,m,o,x,z}.
skeptic.better_predicate: ((in_tok == tok('e')) & (t == 0)) | ((in_tok == tok('h')) & (t == 0)) | ((in_tok == tok('e')) & (t == 1) & ~isin(prev_tok, [tok(c) for c in 'beghimoxz'])) | ((in_tok == tok('e')) & (t == 2) & ~isin(prev_tok, [tok(c) for c in 'beghimoxz']) & ~isin(prev2_tok, [tok(c) for c in 'beghimoxz']))

final_label: First token e or h (always active). Also active on e at t=1 or t=2 unless the preceding token(s) fall in {b,e,g,h,i,m,o,x,z}.
